newsitem.title: USA: Golden Bear up after new pact announced.
newsitem.headline: Golden Bear up after new pact announced.

text.p: Shares of Golden Bear Golf Inc rose after it announced a five-year marketing pact with credit card giant Visa USA.

Shares rose 1-1/8 to 12-5/8 after the deal was released. Visa will promote its exclusive rights as the preferred card of Golden Bear Golf businesses and sponsor two televised golf events produced by Jack Nicklaus Productions.
Golf legend Nicklaus is Golden Bear's chairman and its largest shareholder.
Separately, Citibank said Tuesday it will launch a Citibank Jack Nicklaus Visa Card, which will be offered as a Citibank Platinum Select Card.

The deal gives Visa a chance to link its name with the burgeoning golf industry, which has been revitalized lately by the smashing success of 21-year-old golf sensation Tiger Woods and a growing U.S. economy. Last month, Woods inked a marketing deal with arch-rival American Express Co.
